Taitung, a major city on the southeastern coast of Taiwan

items.chinese: 我這個星期六要去花蓮玩兩天。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zhè ge xīngqíliù yào qù Huālián wán liǎng tiān.
items.english: I am going to Hualien this Saturday for a two-day trip.
When would you like to return to your home country?

items.chinese: 我同學這個週末打算去參觀他朋友的學校。
items.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué zhè ge zhōumò dǎsuàn qù cānguān tā péngyǒu de xuéxiào.
items.english: My classmate plans to visit his friend's school this weekend.

items.chinese: 我有空的時候，常常在家看電視。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu kòng de shíhou, chángcháng zài jiā kàn diànshì.
items.english: When I have free time, I often watch TV at home.
What kinds of films do you like to watch?

items.chinese: 在臺灣坐高鐵旅行，又方便又舒服。
items.pinyin: Zài Táiwān zuò gāotiě lǚxíng, yòu fāngbiàn yòu shūfú.
items.english: Traveling by high-speed rail in Taiwan is both convenient and comfortable.

items.chinese: 我每天都要寫很多功課。
items.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu yào xiě hěn duō gōngkè.
items.english: I have a lot of homework to do every day.

items.chinese: 明華打算星期三下午出去運動。
items.pinyin: Mínghuá dǎsuàn xīngqísān xiàwǔ chūqù yùndòng.
items.english: Minghua plans to go out to exercise on Wednesday afternoon.

items.chinese: 我一天大概上六、七個鐘頭的網。
items.pinyin: Wǒ yì tiān dàgài shàng liù, qī ge zhōngtóu de wǎng.
items.english: I spend about six or seven hours online a day.

items.chinese: 放假的時候，我喜歡在家聽聽音樂、上上網。
items.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan zài jiā tīngting yīnyuè, shàngshang wǎng.
items.english: When I have time off, I like to listen to music and browse the internet at home.

items.chinese: 下個星期放四天的假，我打算跟家人去旅行。
items.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí fàng sì tiān de jià, wǒ dǎsuàn gēn jiārén qù lǚxíng.
items.english: We have four days off next week, and I plan to travel with my family.

items.chinese: 我沒課的時候，有時候在家看影片，有時候出去玩。
items.pinyin: Wǒ méi kè de shíhou, yǒu shíhou zài jiā kàn yǐngpiàn, yǒu shíhou chūqù wán.
items.english: When I have no classes, I sometimes watch films at home and sometimes go out for fun.

items.chinese: 你大概想學多久的中文？
items.pinyin: Nǐ dàgài xiǎng xué duō jiǔ de Zhōngwén?
items.english: About how long would you like to study Chinese?

items.chinese: 臺東是一個風景非常漂亮的地方。
items.pinyin: Táidōng shì yí ge fēngjǐng fēicháng piàoliang de dìfang.
items.english: Taitung is a place with very beautiful scenery.

items.chinese: 田中的女朋友上個星期來臺灣看他。
items.pinyin: Tiánzhōng de nǚ péngyǒu shàng ge xīngqí lái Táiwān kàn tā.
items.english: Tianzhong's girlfriend came to Taiwan to visit him last week.

items.chinese: 安同打算十二月去日本玩。
items.pinyin: Āntóng dǎsuàn shíèr yuè qù Rìběn wán.
items.english: Antong plans to go to Japan for a trip in December.

items.chinese: 你想什麼時候去參觀故宮博物院？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhou qù cānguān Gùgōng Bówùyuàn?
items.english: When would you like to visit the National Palace Museum?
August 17.

items.chinese: 我昨天晚上帶爸爸媽媽去吃越南菜。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang dài bàba māma qù chī Yuènán cài.
items.english: I took my parents out for Vietnamese food last night.

items.chinese: 她是我們書法課的老師。
items.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen shūfǎ kè de lǎoshī.
items.english: She is our calligraphy teacher.

items.chinese: 我明天早上得去銀行，還得跟朋友見面。
items.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang děi qù yínháng, hái děi gēn péngyǒu jiànmiàn.
items.english: I have to go to the bank tomorrow morning, and I also have to meet a friend.

items.chinese: 我想去花蓮玩，你有什麼建議？
items.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù Huālián wán, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì?
items.english: I would like to go to Hualien for a trip. Do you have any suggestions?

items.chinese: 我覺得坐火車去不錯，又便宜又可以看風景。
items.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zuò huǒchē qù búcuò, yòu piányí yòu kěyǐ kàn fēngjǐng.
items.english: I think taking the train is a good idea. It is inexpensive, and you can enjoy the scenery.

items.chinese: 臺灣有很多有名的夜市。
items.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de yèshì.
items.english: There are many famous night markets in Taiwan.

items.chinese: 來臺灣旅行，我覺得應該去逛逛夜市。
items.pinyin: Lái Táiwān lǚxíng, wǒ juéde yīnggāi qù guàngguang yèshì.
items.english: When traveling in Taiwan, I think you should visit a night market.

items.chinese: 聽說你們學校附近的商店都很有意思，我有空想去逛逛。
items.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen xuéxiào fùjìn de shāngdiàn dōu hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yǒu kòng xiǎng qù guàngguang.
items.english: I hear the shops near your school are all interesting. I would like to look around when I have time.

items.chinese: 很多人都說那家店的牛肉麵很特別，我打算明天下課去吃。
items.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu shuō nà jiā diàn de niúròu miàn hěn tèbié, wǒ dǎsuàn míngtiān xiàkè qù chī.
items.english: Many people say that shop's beef noodles are special. I plan to try them after class tomorrow.

items.chinese: 我最近不忙，常去山上的茶館喝茶。
items.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn bù máng, cháng qù shānshàng de cháguǎn hē chá.
items.english: I have not been busy lately, so I often go to the teahouse on the mountain for tea.

items.chinese: 你決定什麼時候開始教我中文？
items.pinyin: Nǐ juédìng shénme shíhou kāishǐ jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén?
items.english: When have you decided to start teaching me Chinese?

items.chinese: 你要是星期天沒事，歡迎來我家坐坐。
items.pinyin: Nǐ yàoshì xīngqítiān méi shì, huānyíng lái wǒ jiā zuòzuo.
items.english: If you have nothing to do on Sunday, you are welcome to visit my home.

items.chinese: 要是你想吃臺灣小吃，就去臺南吧！
items.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ xiǎng chī Táiwān xiǎochī, jiù qù Táinán ba!
items.english: If you want to try Taiwanese snacks, go to Tainan!

items.chinese: 貓空的風景很美，那裡的茶也很好喝。
items.pinyin: Māokōng de fēngjǐng hěn měi, nàlǐ de chá yě hěn hǎohē.
items.english: The scenery in Maokong is beautiful, and the tea there is also delicious.
